job_name: Use device plugins to access external resources with pods
job_statement: When I want to use a particular device such as a GPU with its own vendor-specific setup, I want to use device plugins so that I can utilize such devices without writing custom code.

job_name: Manage hosted control planes across platforms
job_statement: When my clusters are operational, I want to manage them consistently across various platforms, so I can streamline my day-to-day operations.

job_name: Scale workloads in a hosted cluster
job_statement: When application traffic fluctuates, I want to automatically scale my hosted cluster workloads up or down, so I can maintain performance during peak times and reduce infrastructure costs.

job_name: Manually import a hosted cluster

job_name: Delete a hosted cluster

job_name: Manage kernel modules across cluster nodes > Unload kernel modules from nodes

job_name: Remediate node configuration drift to return the node to ready.

job_name: Allow the configuration drift to remain and return the node to ready state.
job_statement: When configuration drift is intentional but I still need the node to update, I can remediate drift by restoring the file contents or blocking drift detection, so I can unblock future machine config rollouts.

job_name: Understand what the `oc get machineconfig node` and `oc describe machineconfig node` output means.

job_name: Define the maximum size of the container log file before it is rotated.

job_name: Switch the container runtime used for workloads on my nodes between runC and crun.
job_statement: When I want to change the container runtime for new workloads on nodes in a specific pool, I can create a `ContainerRuntimeConfig` object, so that I can change between runcC and crun.

job_name: Define how much disk space a single container on my nodes can use for its files and layers.
job_statement: When I want to cap the CRI-O overlay/root partition size on nodes in a specific pool, I can create a `ContainerRuntimeObject` to set the `overlaySize` CRI-O parameter, so I can prevent a single container on those node from consuming the whole node disk.

job_name: Reduce image pull time for operations that require a pull, such as cluster updates or application deployments.
job_statement: When I need to reduce pod startup time for frequently-used images, I can use a `PinnedImageSet` to pin container images to a machine config pools, so I can reduce image pull time and ensure critical images are always available locally to the nodes in that pool.
